chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: The Big Jamboree folds in Kansas City and he is stranded
summary: Basie says the Gonzel White show, called the Big Jamboree, was stranded in Kansas City, which led to his illness and later joining Walter Page.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
